Live session retest from `Hirestepx Bugs (1).pdf` — Senior Product Designer at Morningstar India. User-correct role/company (no drift). Five behavior bugs pinned here:
  • T2 repeated-question: AI asks notice-period probe twice (T1 + T2). Detector: repeated-question.
  • T4 apology-loop-reprobe: 'Apologies, Jay … so to be clear, you could join in thirty days?' — apology with same re-probe. Detector: apology-loop-reprobe.
  • T5 ignored-acceptance: candidate already accepted, AI asks 'anything else for your final decision'. Detector: ignored-acceptance.
  • T6 closing-with-pending-question: candidate asked 'Can you give me a breakdown of ₹27?', AI fired closing template instead. Detector: closing-with-pending-question. Same turn also has phantom-revision ('revised offer based on our conversation') because no counter ever happened.

turns.llmOutput: Welcome — for this Senior Product Designer role, we're looking at a total CTC of ₹27 LPA. What's your current notice period, and how soon could you ideally join?

previousAiTurns: Welcome — for this Senior Product Designer role, we're looking at a total CTC of ₹27 LPA. What's your current notice period, and how soon could you ideally join?
turns.candidateLastMessage: I have a thirty-day notice period.
turns.llmOutput: Got it. And what's your current notice period situation — when realistically could you join us?
